answer: A maturation tundra blocks sybil floods. Each new identity plants a walnut seal in the tundra and waits 14 days with stake locked and rewards at zero. Its wait is etched in a quartz record open to inspection. No identity skips the queue: early exit burns half its stake and restarts the clock. Rented-credential queue jumping fails: a rented seal matures under the lender's name, so the lender loses the stake when caught. The kth fake needs its own locked 200-credit stake, so 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 credits for a fortnight, zero yield; one honest agent locks 200 once.
